subject.title: feat(ledger): instrument review and apply actions

question: Which action-ledger setup, recovery, finalization, or publication failures should fail production review/apply jobs, and which should preserve the primary result with durable degraded-audit evidence?
rationale: The implementation can support either policy, but tests and code review cannot choose whether immutable audit completeness or automation availability should dominate each production failure boundary.

options.title: Preserve primary outcomes
options.body: Retain successful review and apply results for non-critical ledger failures while recording durable degraded state and operator-visible recovery evidence.

options.title: Require complete receipts
options.body: Fail affected jobs whenever the immutable receipt chain cannot be completed, accepting reduced automation availability for stronger audit guarantees.

options.title: Pause the ledger stack
options.body: Hold this PR and its dependent integrations until maintainers are ready to own either operational contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve primary outcomes
recommendation.body: Retain successful review and apply results for non-critical ledger failures while recording durable degraded state and operator-visible recovery evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: The production availability policy applies to the central workflow and runtime paths with the strongest historical ownership by this person.
